crossRefs.note: He walked in all the ways that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshiped them;

translations.web: He walked in all the ways that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshiped them;
translations.bsb: He walked in all the ways of his father, and he served and worshiped the idols his father had served.
